name: afc-lite
title: AFC Lite (Automated Filament Changer)
author: bespoked
description: Lightweight Automated Filament Changer support for the Snapmaker U1's four toolheads. Ships the AFC, AFC_unit and AFC_lane Klipper extras plus an afc.cfg that maps the four lanes (E0-E3) to the U1 extruders and filament motion sensors, and adds gcode macros for color, material, vendor, map, spool id, weight, tool change and lane/tool unload. Per-lane state feeds the U1's SET_PRINT_FILAMENT_CONFIG so the slicer and screen track what is loaded.
tagline: Four-lane filament tracking and tool-change macros for the U1.

variables.name: AFC_TOOLMAP_ASK
variables.description: Hold a print before it starts so the web interface can make the lane-to-tool map: on or off.

config.label: Hold a print until the lane-to-tool map is made
config.hint: Off by default. On, a print started from the web interface or the slicer never starts until Fluidd or Mainsail has asked which lane feeds each tool, so a print sent straight from the slicer can be mapped without the printer's screen. It waits as long as it takes, and dismissing the question drops the print instead of starting it.
